auth.title: Public API
auth.snippet:
Welcome to this comprehensive guide for the Systeme.io Public API. Our API serves as a bridge, enabling developers to interact with Systeme's core functionalities programmatically. It is meticulously designed to offer a seamless integration experience, allowing you to manage contacts, tags, and a variety of other operations integral to our platform. Adhering to RESTful conventions, our API ensures an intuitive and consistent interaction pattern for all users.
#
Getting Started
To begin using the Systeme.io Public API, you must first obtain an authentication key. This key is your ticket to unlocking the API's capabilities. Simply navigate to the profile settings within your Systeme.io dashboard, and generate a new key under the "Public API keys" section. Once you have your key, you're all set to embark on your first API request journey!

Authentication
To authenticate with the Systeme.io Public API, your only option right now is to attach your API key to the `X-API-Key` header of each request. Let us know which authentication methods you would like to see implemented next!
#
Rate-Limiting
Our Public API implements a rate-limiting system to maintain service stability and availability for all users. Here's how it works:
- **Refill Rate**: Your request quota is periodically replenished. The `X-RateLimit-Refill` header indicates when the next quota refill will occur.
- **Limit Ceiling**: There is a maximum quota limit, which is the total number of requests you can make within a given time frame. The `X-RateLimit-Limit` header shows this maximum number.
- **Shared Quota**: The request limit is collectively applied across all your API keys and tokens. The `X-RateLimit-Remaining` header informs you of the number of requests left in your current rate limit window.
If you exceed the rate limit, you will receive a `429` Too Many Requests response status code. This indicates that you have sent too many requests in a given time frame. Along with this response, you will receive a `Retry-After` header indicating the number of seconds to wait before making a new request. We advise implementing appropriate error handling strategies in your application to manage these responses effectively.
#
Using the API
Our documentation is your roadmap to the Systeme.io Public API. It details the endpoints available, their respective URLs, the expected formats for requests and responses, and outlines the basic constraints to be aware of.

## 3. How to generate your API keys
API keys are unique identifiers that authenticate requests to our public API. They enable you to programmatically access and manage various resources on our platform.
To connect an external integration, you first need to generate a secure API key. Click on your profile picture and select **Settings** (1). In the left menu, click **MCP & API keys** (2).
![](/uploads/migrated/fa6ffd3ee9cb3003499ac29b.png)
Scroll down to the Public API keys section and click **Create** (3).
![](/uploads/migrated/e3685ff42c8459acffc06b30.png)
Give your key a name, set an expiration date, and click **Save** (4).
![](/uploads/migrated/2b88b528594830eccc5a10ca.png)
> **Note:** To keep your API key active indefinitely, leave the 'Expiration' field empty.
Your key is now ready.
![](/uploads/migrated/4b128832d665adb618c1aeff.png)

> **Notes:**
>
> - To easily identify and manage your tokens, each must have a unique name.
> - A token can only be copied immediately after creating it. If you forgot to copy your token, delete it and create a new one.
> - As a security measure, we will send you an email notification whenever a new public API key is created in your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account.
> - You can create up to** 3 API keys** per account.
Learn more: [API documentation](https://developer.systeme.io/reference/api).

auth.title: How to build a systeme.io API integration
Systeme.io API Authentication
auth.snippet:
# Systeme.io API Authentication
How to authenticate Systeme.io API requests: one Bearer API key plus a connectionId. MindCloud stores your API key securely — set it once, never resend it.
Every Systeme.io API request through MindCloud needs two things: a **MindCloud API Key** and a `connectionId` for your Systeme.io account. This page covers both, plus exactly how to send them, so you do not need to visit any other page to get authenticated.
## Steps to authenticate
1. Create a **MindCloud account** at [app.mindcloud.co](https://app.mindcloud.co) if you do not already have one.
2. Generate a **MindCloud API Key** in [API Keys](https://app.mindcloud.co/user/api-keys). This is the Bearer token you send on every request. Keep it on your server.
3. Create a **Systeme.io connection** in [Connections](https://app.mindcloud.co/credentials). Systeme.io uses an API key. You generate the key in your Systeme.io account, then paste it in when you create the connection — MindCloud stores it securely and never returns it in a response.
4. Copy the connection’s `connectionId` — you will send it on every request alongside your MindCloud API Key.
## How requests are authenticated
Authentication has two layers. Your **MindCloud API Key** authenticates the request to MindCloud, sent as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. The `connectionId` selects the connected Systeme.io account that should run the action. MindCloud stores and refreshes the Systeme.io credentials behind that connection, so you never send provider tokens with your requests.
Pass `connectionId` in the query string for `GET` and `DELETE` actions, and in the JSON body for `POST`, `PUT`, and `PATCH` actions.
For example, calling **List Tags** with an Systeme.io connection looks like this:
```
curl --request POST \
--url "https://connect.mindcloud.co/v2/universal/apps/systemeio/actions/list-tags/run" \
--header "Authorization: Bearer $MINDCLOUD_API_KEY" \
--header "Content-Type: application/json" \
--data '{
"connectionId": "$CONNECTION_ID",
"arguments": {}
}'
```
The `Authorization: Bearer <your MindCloud API Key>` header authenticates you to MindCloud; the `connectionId` tells MindCloud which Systeme.io account to run the action against. Missing or invalid Authorization returns `401`, and a missing or mismatched `connectionId` returns `400`.

mcp.title: MCP Server
mcp.snippet:
Welcome to the Systeme.io MCP Server overview. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard designed to connect AI models with external data and tools. Our MCP server acts as a bridge between your Systeme.io account and AI-powered environments (such as ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, or other MCP-compatible clients).
By leveraging the MCP server, you can grant AI agents the ability to perform contact (contacts, tags, and contact fields) and newsletter management actions within your account using natural language commands. This integration significantly enhances productivity by bringing your contact data (contacts, tags, and fields) into the AI’s context window.
#
Getting Started
To begin using the Systeme.io MCP server, you must first obtain an MCP key. You can generate a new key by navigating to the profile settings within your Systeme.io dashboard under the ["MCP & API keys"](https://systeme.io/dashboard/profile/public-api-settings) section. Once you have your key, you can configure your MCP-compatible client to connect to our server.

Security is a priority for our integration. To authenticate with the MCP server, you must use your MCP key. The server supports two authentication methods to provide flexibility across different MCP clients:
- **HTTP Header**: Attach your MCP key to the `X-MCP-Key` header.
- **Query Parameter**: Include your MCP key as the `mcpKey` parameter in the request URL.
This dual-method approach ensures that you can connect your AI tools even if the client has limitations on custom header configuration.
#
Supported operations
The Systeme.io MCP server currently supports **contact and newsletter management**. The following operations are available:
- **Contacts:** list, retrieve, create, update, delete
- **Tags:** list, retrieve, create, update, delete
- **Tag assignment:** assign or remove tags from contacts
- **Contact fields:** list available contact fields (field slugs)
- **Newsletters:** create, update, find and review existing ones
At this stage, these are the only capabilities exposed by the MCP server. Other Systeme.io features are not yet supported. Additional functionality may be introduced as the MCP server evolves.

mcp.title: How to connect your systeme.io account to ChatGPT using MCP keys
mcp.snippet:
What you will need:
- A [systeme.io](systeme.io) account
- An MCP key generated from your systeme.io account ([How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protoco](https://help.systeme.io/article/9489-how-to-use-systeme-ios-mcp#3-How-to-generate-your-MCP-keys-usC9d)l)
- A ChatGPT account
To connect [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) to ChatGPT using an MCP key, log in to your ChatGPT account, open the left side menu, and click **Plugins** (1).

In the setup popup, enter the following details:
- **Name (4):** [Systeme.io](http://Systeme.io) MCP
- **Description (optional) (5):** [Systeme.io](http://Systeme.io) official MCP server
- **Connection (6):** Server URL
- **Server URL (7):** [https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOUR_KEY](https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOUR_KEY)
> **Note:** Replace YOUR_KEY with the MCP key you created on your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account.
- **Authentication (8):** No Authentication
Tick the **I understand and want to continue** box (9), then click **Create as a plugin** (10).

mcp.title: How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol)
mcp.snippet:
The new MCP server feature gives users, partners, and developers a powerful new way to interact with [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) using AI tools.
## 1. What is MCP?
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard that enables AI assistants (such as ChatGPT or Claude) to connect securely to external platforms.
With MCP, you can use natural language commands to interact with your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) data. For example, you can ask ChatGPT to find a contact or add a tag just by typing a sentence.
Our MCP feature currently provides direct access to specific contact-management features, allowing you to use AI to manage your contacts, tags, and contact fields.
## 2. How does our MCP server work?
The [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) MCP server allows AI applications to access specific contact-management tools within your account.
It creates a bridge between:
- **The host**: Your AI tool (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude).
- **The server:** Your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account.
Once connected, the AI can execute commands to manage your contacts and tags automatically.
For technical details, please refer to our official MCP documentation: [https://developer.systeme.io/docs/mcp-server](https://developer.systeme.io/docs/mcp-server)
## 3. How to generate your MCP keys
To connect an AI tool, you first need to generate a secure MCP key.
Click on your profile picture and select **Settings** (1). In the left menu, click **MCP & API keys** (2).

You can use AI tools to perform the following actions:
**a. Contact management:**
- **Create and update contacts:** Add new contacts or update existing ones.
- **Delete contacts:** Remove contacts from your list.
- **List and retrieve contacts:** Use filters to list contacts or fetch specific contact details.
- **Manage tags:** Create, assign, list, and remove tags from contacts.
- **Retrieve contact fields (custom fields):** List available contact fields and their identifiers (slugs) so the AI can correctly fill in and update contact information.

mcp.title: How to manage your funnels with the systeme.io MCP server
mcp.snippet:
In this article, you will learn how to manage your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) funnels using natural language through our native MCP server. By connecting an AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude, you can easily create and retrieve funnels and opt-in funnel steps seamlessly without leaving your chat window.
What you will need:
- A [systeme.io](http://systeme.io/) account
- An MCP key generated from your systeme.io account ([How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol))](https://help.systeme.io/article/9489-how-to-use-systeme-ios-mcp#3-How-to-generate-your-MCP-keys-usC9d)
- An AI tool connected to your systeme.io account using MCP keys:
- [How to connect your systeme.io account with Claude using MCP keys](https://help.systeme.io/article/11230-how-to-connect-your-systemeio-account-with-claude-using-mcp-keys)
- [How to connect your systeme.io account with ChatGPT using MCP keys](https://help.systeme.io/article/11229-how-to-connect-your-systemeio-account-with-chatgpt-using-mcp-keys)

The MCP server allows you to perform basic actions on your funnels directly from the chat. Just provide the name of the funnel and specify the action you want to perform.

mcp.title: How to connect your systeme.io account to Claude using MCP keys
mcp.snippet:
What you will need:
- A[systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account
- An MCP key generated from your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account ([How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol](/article/9489-how-to-use-systeme-ios-mcp#3-How-to-generate-your-MCP-keys-usC9d))
- A Claude account (The feature is available for all plans)
You can connect [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) to Claude using their Connectors feature. This works on [Claude.ai](http://Claude.ai) (Web), the Claude desktop app, and Claude mobile apps.

In the setup popup, enter the following details:
- **Name** (5)**:** [systeme.io](http://systeme.io)
- **Remote MCP server URL** (6)**:** [https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOURMCPKEY](https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOURMCPKEY)
> **Note:** Replace YOURMCPKEY with the **MCP key you created on your** [**systeme.io**](http://systeme.io)** account.**

mcp.title: Run your business with AI
mcp.snippet:
systeme.io includes a built-in MCP server that lets you **connect AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude directly to your account**. Once connected, your AI can access your content to create and manage things like funnels, contacts, courses, and products, and even chain several actions together in a single request. Sensitive actions always require your confirmation first.

Generate a secure MCP key from your account settings, then use it to connect your favorite AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude
### Let AI access your content
Give your AI context before asking it to act. Ask how many email campaigns you have and what's inside a specific one, so it has everything it needs to start creating content for you

The systeme.io MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is a standard that securely connects your systeme.io account to AI assistants like ChatGPT or Claude. It allows you to interact with your business data using natural language, enabling you to build funnels, manage contacts, and create email campaigns just by typing simple commands in your chat window.

When you connect via MCP, you are in control of the permissions granted to the AI.
